sections.Interpretation: Total white cell count is markedly reduced at 0.9 x10^9/L, with neutrophils forming 22% of the differential, giving an absolute neutrophil count of about 0.2 x10^9/L. This is severe neutropenia. The findings are in keeping with chemotherapy-induced myelosuppression in a patient who is ten days after a cycle of treatment for breast cancer. Haemoglobin is 11.4 g/dL with normocytic red cell indices (MCV about 88 fL, MCH about 29.6 pg, MCHC about 33.5 g/dL), indicating mild normocytic anaemia. Platelets are mildly reduced at 95 x10^9/L, also most likely treatment-related.
sections.Comment/recommendation: CRITICAL VALUE: Absolute neutrophil count of approximately 0.2 x10^9/L (severe neutropenia). Recommend urgent clinical assessment for febrile neutropenia given the reported fever. Immediate senior medical review is advised, with blood cultures and empirical broad-spectrum antibiotics started without delay in line with local febrile neutropenia protocol.
